MECA.TITLE: Display Precautions for Using Parallel Parking Guide

ITEM.PTXT: Even when parallel parking with the parallel parking guide, the vehicle may collide with something depending on the operation method, road conditions, road surface conditions and vehicle conditions when parking; always drive while directly confirming that it is safe behind and around the vehicle.
Use the parallel parking guide when parking on a flat, straight road. Do not use it when the parking position is on a curve or slope. Doing so may result in a collision or an unexpected accident.
The space required for parking varies slightly depending on vehicle conditions (number of occupants, load, etc.) and road conditions (gradient, unevenness, etc.).
